faq.a: Zhandos is associated with Kazakh. Zhandos is Kazakh, from жан ('soul') + дос ('friend'), meaning 'soul-friend'.
No — the underlying form is Kazakh, not Arabic.
Zhandos can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Kazakh-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
